struct.name: INDEX_DATA_WORDS_SIPF
struct.doc: Labelling of fields within Index Data.

struct.name: VERTEX_FORMAT_WORD_SIPF2
struct.doc: This contains information such as number of vertices in the primitive block and more information about the structure of the primitive block. It is stored in the memory at CS_PRIM_BASE, along with optional ISP State Words.

field.name: vf_isp_format_word
field.doc: Offset in 64-bit words from the 1st ISP vertex word to the 1st PDS state word.

field.name: vf_isp_state_size
field.doc: ISP state size in units of 32-bit words.

field.name: vf_tsp_vtx_raw
field.doc: If set, TSP varyings are not compressed and there are no TSP varying floor or format fields present.

field.name: vf_isp_vtx_raw
field.doc: If set, ISP vertices are not compressed and there are no ISP vertex floor or format fields present.

field.name: vf_varying_total_16
field.doc: Total number of 16-bit varyings per vertex.

field.name: vf_varying_total_32
field.doc: Total number of 32-bit varyings per vertex.

field.name: vf_varying_vertex_bits
field.doc: Compressed varying size per vertex in bits.

field.name: vf_primitive_total
field.doc: The number of primitives in the primitive block minus 1 i.e. 0 means 1 primitive.

field.name: vf_vertex_total
field.doc: The number of vertices in the primitive block minus 1 i.e. 0 means 1 vertex.

field.name: vf_prim_msaa_disable
field.doc: If set, MSAA is disabled in this primitive block and all pixel sub-samples are rasterised at the default grid offset.

field.name: vf_vertex_clipped
field.doc: If set, TSP Vertex data has been generated by the clipper.

field.name: cs_valid_tile3
field.doc: If set, then there is at least 1 primitive in this primitive block in tile 3.

field.name: cs_valid_tile2
field.doc: If set, then there is at least 1 primitive in this primitive block in tile 2.

field.name: cs_valid_tile1
field.doc: If set, then there is at least 1 primitive in this primitive block in tile 1.

field.name: cs_valid_tile0
field.doc: If set, then there is at least 1 primitive in this primitive block in tile 0.

field.name: cs_mask_num_bytes
field.doc: The size of each tile bit-based mask in bytes, between 1 to 3 bytes. 1 = 1 byte, 2 = 2 bytes, 3 = 3 bytes, 0 = reserved.

field.name: cs_prim_base_size
field.doc: If set, then the (full) Primitive Base word is present for the primitive block. If not set, the Primitive Base Offset is present for the primitive block.

field.name: cs_ctrl_type
field.doc: 00b Primitive Block.

struct.name: PRIMITIVE_FORMAT
struct.doc: Labelling of fields within Primitive Format.

field.name: cs_type
field.doc: 00b Primitive Block.

field.name: cs_isp_state_read
field.doc: If set, then ISP state must be read from the primitive block.

field.name: cs_isp_state_size
field.doc: The total number of ISP state words in the primitive block.

field.name: cs_prim_total
field.doc: The number of primitives in the primitive block minus 1 i.e. 0 means 1 primitive.

field.name: cs_mask_fmt
field.doc: The format of the encoding of primitive mask data for the primitive block.

field.name: cs_prim_base_pres
field.doc: If set, then the Primitive Base Pointer word is present for the primitive block. Always set when using a byte-based primitive mask.

field.name: cs_prim_base_offset
field.doc: This is a 32-bit aligned, unsigned offset which is capable of accessing a 256 KB range. This offset replaces the 16 LSBs of the previous primitive base in order to generate the current primitive base.

field.doc: A 32-bit aligned address which is capable of accessing a 16 GB range.
